question: Who among the following is one of the Deputy Chief Ministers of Uttar Pradesh as of July 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Keshav Prasad Maurya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Keshav Prasad Maurya** is one of the Deputy Chief Ministers of Uttar Pradesh as of July 2023.
 
• He has been serving as the Deputy Chief Minister since **19 March 2017**, following the BJP's victory in the state assembly elections.
 
• Maurya has a significant political career and is known for his work in the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**.
 
• He represents the **Sirka constituency** in the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Deputy Chief Minister:**

 
 
• A Deputy Chief Minister (DCM) is a member of the executive branch of the state government in India who typically acts as the second-in-command to the Chief Minister.
 
• The position is not a constitutional post but can be created by the ruling party to balance power within the party or coalition.
 
• DCMs may handle important portfolios and play a crucial role in the administration of the state.
 
 
 
• **Uttar Pradesh:**
 
 
• Uttar Pradesh is a state in northern India, known for its historical, cultural, and political significance.
 
• It is the most populous state in India and has a diverse socio-economic structure.
 
• The capital of Uttar Pradesh is Lucknow, and it has a major legislative and administrative setup.
 
 
 
• **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP):**
 
 
• The Bharatiya Janata Party is one of the two major political parties in India, alongside the Indian National Congress.
 
• Founded in 1980, the BJP follows a right-wing political ideology and promotes policies that reflect Hindu nationalist positions.
 
• It is currently the ruling party in India and has a significant presence in various states, including Uttar Pradesh.
 
 
 
• **Yogi Adityanath:**
 
 
• Yogi Adityanath is the current Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, having assumed office on 19 March 2017.
 
• He is known for his strong leadership and focus on law and order, development, and cultural heritage of the state.
 
• Prior to becoming the Chief Minister, he served as a Member of Parliament from the Gorakhpur constituency for five consecutive terms.
